description: Auto-Approval Rule entity (p2, PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-auto-approval). With effect 'approve', a matching enabled rule approves a request without human review where approval is required; it never overrides a deny rule or a deny decision, and it satisfies only policies whose scope tenant is the rule's scope tenant or a descendant. With effect 'block_descendants', the rule disables auto-approval of strict descendants of its scope tenant for matching opportunities. This type is the subject type of auto-approval rule change events (DESIGN cpt-cf-approval-service-entity-auto-approval-rule).

resource_selector.description: Exactly one of a projection type pattern or one specific projection.

condition.description: Optional CEL condition over opportunity, subject, projection, and context attributes. Absent: matches unconditionally. An evaluation failure means not matching.

effect.description: 'approve' (default) or 'block_descendants'. Enum evolution: new effects only in a new major.
